description: Names the features in the project's build and finds the same feature in public apps FlyTrap has crawled, with screenshots of each. Returns the feature rows, the compared apps (pinned competitors first, then the most downloaded apps in the same store genre, or every app by shared functions with match: "overlap"), how many features they share and signed screenshot URLs.
name: get_ux_benchmark
title: UX benchmark: your features next to other apps
